entity.summary: Australia-based cryptocurrency exchange / service provider founded on 2013-04-10. Kraken announced its acquisition of Bit Trade on 2020-01-14. Bit Trade subsequently continued as a Payward subsidiary and later operated Kraken services for Australian customers.
entity.notes: HEI models the independent BitTrade Australia exchange/service identity as acquired on 2020-01-14. Federal Court findings state that Bit Trade was incorporated on 2013-04-10 and conducted a digital currency exchange from that time, and that after the January 2020 acquisition it became a Payward subsidiary and continued providing Kraken Exchange access to Australian customers. The terminal date therefore marks loss of independent exchange identity, not dissolution of Bit Trade Pty Ltd.

events.title: Bit Trade began operating a digital currency exchange
events.description: Federal Court findings state that Bit Trade was incorporated on 10 April 2013 and conducted a digital currency exchange from that time.
events.notes: The launch date is tied to the court-recorded incorporation date because the judgment expressly states that Bit Trade conducted a digital currency exchange from that time.

events.title: Kraken acquired Bit Trade
events.description: Kraken announced that it had acquired Bit Trade to expand AUD liquidity, spot trading and OTC services in Australia.
events.notes: The acquisition ended Bit Trade's independent exchange/service identity but not the legal entity; later court and ASIC materials show Bit Trade continuing as the Australian Kraken service provider.

evidence.title: Australian Securities and Investments Commission v Bit Trade Pty Ltd [2024] FCA 953
evidence.notes: Paragraph 6 states that Bit Trade was incorporated on 2013-04-10 and conducted a digital currency exchange from that time; paragraphs 6-7 also state that it was acquired by the Payward Group in January 2020 and continued providing Kraken Exchange access afterwards.

evidence.title: Kraken Acquires Australia’s Longest-Running Crypto Service Provider Bit Trade
evidence.notes: First-party acquisition announcement confirming Kraken acquired Bit Trade on 2020-01-14 and intended to expand its Australian AUD, spot and OTC offering.

evidence.title: ASIC wins case against Kraken crypto exchange operator for design and distribution failure
evidence.notes: Regulatory notice identifies Bit Trade Pty Ltd as the operator of the Kraken crypto exchange in Australia, supporting post-acquisition legal and operational continuity.

expected.summary: Australia-based cryptocurrency exchange / service provider founded in 2013. Kraken acquired Bit Trade on 2020-01-14, bringing the Bit Trade team into Kraken Australia and using the acquisition to expand AUD liquidity, spot exchange, and OTC services in the Australian market.
expected.notes: HEI models BitTrade Australia as acquired because Kraken acquired the Australian crypto service provider on 2020-01-14. Later regulatory materials refer to Bit Trade Pty Ltd as the operator/provider of Kraken services in Australia, so this is not a dead exchange record; the terminal date marks the end of the independent Bit Trade exchange/service identity.
